job.job_description:
Job Details

Location: Gurugram
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday | 5 Days Working
Weekly Off: Saturday & Sunday | Fixed Off
Shift Timing: 10:00 AM 7:00 PM
Contract: 1 Year
Experience: 23 Years
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech/MCA or equivalent

Role: Full Stack Web Application Developer

We are looking for a proactive Full Stack Developer who can own applications end-to-end from requirement gathering, architecture, design and development to deployment, performance and production stability.

What You’ll Do

Architect, develop, enhance and deploy high-performance web applications.
• Translate business requirements into scalable, secure and robust solutions.
• Work independently on existing/inherited codebases, reverse-engineer logic and improve production systems without impacting stability.
• Collaborate with business, consulting and cross-functional teams throughout the SDLC.
• Provide technical recommendations, contribute to solution design, IP/content development and technical training.
• Follow coding, security, Git, CI/CD and DevOps best practices.
• Work with large datasets and identify opportunities for automation, analytics and AI-driven improvements.

Must-Have Tech Stack

Backend: Python – Django / Flask / FastAPI
• Frontend: React / Angular, HTML5, CSS3, TypeScript
• Database: SQL, MySQL, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL; MongoDB knowledge
• Cloud & DevOps: Azure / GCP / Oracle Cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps
• Storage & Data: AWS S3, Data Lakes
• Tools: Unix/Linux command line, Git, GitHub/GitLab
• UI/Visualization: UI component libraries, Highcharts / Recharts, Figma & basic wireframing

Good to Have

ML/AutoML: Azure ML, SageMaker
• Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, OpenAI / Claude
• Automation & orchestration: n8n, Airflow, Prefect
• ML/Analytics: Regression, Classification, Clustering, EDA
• R, SPSS, Alteryx, VBA
• Tableau, Power BI, Excel & PowerPoint
• Survey/behavioral data, survey design, weighting & advanced survey analytics

What We Value

Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking and solutioning ability
• Fast learner who can understand complex architectures and undocumented systems
• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills
• Ability to explain technical concepts and analytical insights to non-technical audiences
• Collaborative mindset with experience working across global, cross-functional teams and external partners
• Proactive, ownership-driven approach with strong follow-through and service excellence

Education & Experience

Bachelor's / Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology or equivalent with strong academic performance.
• 2–3 years of commercial end-to-end web application/tool development experience, preferably in a services or consulting environment.



If Interested share your cv on:

dinjal.mehta@persolapac.com
